summary: All 7 ui items fixed and checked on the release player Build/ui/PainterIO.exe. (1) CanvasScaler switched to screenMatchMode Expand, so the whole 1080 x 1920 design box is always on screen. The cards now sit in a CardRow that scales down only when a horizontal safe-area inset makes the safe area too narrow. Menu, Results and Pause no longer collide at 9:16, 20:9, 21:9, 3:4, 432x960, 1080x1200 or landscape 1280x720, and the 540x960 layout is pixel-identical to the Gate B shots. (2) Toasts never go below scale 0.85. With the board open they move centered below the board (and below a visible tutorial bubble), and a line too long for one row wraps to two lines. The saved line is now 16 to 19 px tall at 960 px (was 8 to 12). (3) The rival chevron is at alpha 0.9, 28x18, with a navy outline, and reads over gold and neon-yellow beds. (4) Menu: a soft navy CardsScrim behind the picker, opaque unselected card faces, and the attract camera zoomed out to view scale 1.4. (5) An AttractCover fades the ended attract board to navy, seals to opaque just before the 2 s restart, and fades the new match in, with no single-frame pop (luminance trace and frames checked). (6) Results: dim raised from 0.74 to 0.86 (backdrop 22 to 27 % darker), paragraphs 880 wide, and the lines are stacked from their measured heights, so an empty WHY line leaves no band (33 px gap instead of 102 px at 960 px). (7) Only the selected biome preview repaints, 15 times per second; the corner mask is cached. Sim is untouched: probe PASS with hash 246577239DE179C4 at 540x960 and 540x1200. EditMode: 52/52 in the owned suites (12 new WaveC_Ui tests plus 1 new camera test). The full suite ran 486 tests with 1 failure, which is outside this package (WaveC_BiomeFireTests em-dash check on the biome-fire package's own file, mid-edit).

items.evidence: UiKit.CreateCanvas uses UiKit.ScreenMatch = CanvasScaler.ScreenMatchMode.Expand (MatchWidthOrHeight constant removed; UiKit.CanvasSizeFor added). UiStringsTests.UiRoot_FollowsTheUguiRules now asserts Expand. MenuScreen: the three cards are children of a 'CardRow' (962 wide) scaled by CardRowScale(Safe.rect.width) = min(1, (w - 32) / 962), recomputed in Tick when the safe width changes. Positions kept (title TopCenter -340, Biome label BottomCenter +1327, results stats/tag stack, REJOUER +440, Pause title Center +470), now exposed as constants for the tests. Tests: WaveC_CanvasExpandKeepsTheWholeDesignBoxAtEveryAspect, WaveC_CardRowScalesOnlyWhenTheSafeAreaIsNarrower, WaveC_MenuResultsAndPauseLayoutsStayApartAtTheCheckedAspects (8 screens: title vs Biome label >= 60 units, card rim >= 8 px from the edge, full results stack above REJOUER, Pause title >= 100 units below the HUD timer). Release shots under docs/waveC/ui/: probe_liquid_540x960(_final)/menu.png and results.png have the same layout as docs/waveB/shots/gate/liquid_menu.png and liquid_results.png. ds_liquid_540x1200 (20:9), ds_liquid_514x1200 (21:9), ds_liquid_900x1200 (3:4), ds_liquid_432x960 and ds_liquid_1080x1200: in every liquid_menu.png the title, Biome label, cards, swatches and JOUER never overlap and the card rims are 23 to 120 px from the screen edge; in every liquid_results.png REJOUER and MENU cover neither the cause line nor the stats line. The title is back at 1080x1200 (it was missing in docs/waveC/robustness/p_1080x2400/menu.png). ds_liquid_1280x720_pause/liquid_CutDroplets.png: the Pause title sits well below the HUD timer (they overlapped in docs/waveC/robustness/ds_1280x720_ui). ds_liquid_1280x720_board: the HUD board, the toast, the tutorial bubble with its pointer and the steering hint are all inside the screen in landscape. The landscape Options panel fits (ds_liquid_1280x720_pause/liquid_menu.png). Fire and electric menus at 540x960 and 540x1200 were also checked. The 1080x2400, 1080x2520 and 1200x1600 checks used windows of the same aspect (540x1200, 514x1200, 900x1200) because the desktop is 1920x1200 and Windows clamps taller windows (the critic's '1080x2400' run was actually 1080x1200). The canvas depends only on the aspect, and CanvasSizeFor covers the exact sizes in the tests.

Hud.TickToasts uses the new internal static Hud.ToastLayout(safeWidth, toastWidth, boardOpen[, avoidTop, avoidBottom]), which returns a ToastPlacement (scale, position, size, wrap). Rules: scale = clamp((width - 40) / w, MinToastScale 0.85, 1). If w * 0.85 > width - 40, the toast wraps to two lines (size width - 64 x 150, scale 1, Text horizontalOverflow Wrap with padding); ShowToast restores single-line sizing. With the board open, a toast that would overlap Hud.BoardRect moves centered to board bottom - 24 - half its height, and further below the tutorial bubble band when that bubble is visible (read-only lookup of TutorialOverlay's 'Bubble' rect). In landscape a short toast stays at its usual height because it already clears the board. Tests: WaveC_ToastLayoutNeverScalesBelowTheMinimumAndAlwaysFits (6 safe widths x 30 toast widths x board on and off), WaveC_ToastLayoutNeverOverlapsTheOpenBoard, WaveC_ToastLayoutAvoidsTheTutorialBubbleBelowTheBoard, WaveC_TheSavedLineStaysReadable. Repros with the critics' setup: docs/waveC/ui/ds_fire_432x960_fr_board/fire_SavedReturn.png (-lang fr -uidemo board) and ds_liquid_540x960_en_board/liquid_SavedReturn.png (-lang en -uidemo board,hint). In both, the saved line is fully on screen, centered just below the board and not covering it. Measured text bounding box: 16 px (FR, 432x960) and 19 px (EN, 540x960), against 8 px and 12 px with the same measure on docs/waveC/rules-and-flow/fr_fire_tall and en_liquid.

Hud rival chevron: alpha 0.55 -> 0.9 (Hud.ChevronAlpha, applied at build time and in Tick), size 24x16 -> 28x18 (Hud.ChevronSize, same center), plus an Outline in navy #151D38 alpha 0.8 with effectDistance (2, -2). No HUD element moved. Test: WaveC_BuiltUiHasTheScrimCoverOpaqueFacesAndOutlinedChevron checks size, alpha and outline. Release shots at 1080 px width: docs/waveC/ui/zoom_fire_chevron_over_bed_1080.png (fire, gold bed) and zoom_electric_chevron_over_bed_1080.png (electric, neon-yellow bed), cropped from ds_fire_1080x1200/fire_SavedReturn.png and ds_electric_1080x1200/electric_SavedReturn.png. The chevron is clearly visible with its navy rim, compared with docs/waveC/visuals/zoom_fire_hud_over_bed_1080.png and zoom_electric_hud_over_bed_1080.png. At the PocketPending checkpoint of this run the chevron sits over the purple bed, also clearly visible, so the bright-bed check used the SavedReturn checkpoint, where the gold and neon-yellow beds are under the HUD.

MenuScreen: a 'CardsScrim' Image (UiKit.Navy, alpha 0.45, new UiKit.SoftBandSprite with 60 units of feathering at top and bottom, Sliced, raycastTarget false). It spans from 40 units below the swatch ring row to 30 units above the Biome label on the same BottomCenter references, overhangs the safe area's sides so it covers the full canvas width, and is the first child of the safe area (above TopShade and BottomShade, below every content element). TickCards: unselected face = UiKit.PanelNavy, fully opaque (was alpha 0.88). CameraRig: public const AttractZoom = 1.4 and public static ZoomTargetFor(CameraMode), used as the zoom base in Attract (and for ResultsHold, unchanged value). AttractHalfLife is unchanged. Tests: InputCameraMathTests.Camera_AttractScaleTargetZoomsOutTheMenuMatch (new; all 31 InputCameraMathTests green), WaveC_BuiltUiHasTheScrimCoverOpaqueFacesAndOutlinedChevron. Release menus at 540x960 and 540x1200 in the three biomes (docs/waveC/ui/probe_liquid_540x960/menu.png, ds_liquid_540x1200, ds_fire_540x960, ds_fire_540x1200, ds_electric_540x960, ds_electric_540x1200): no puddle shows through an unselected card face, attract puddles behind the color row are dimmed and smaller, and the selected card (rim, scale 1.06) and the selected swatch ring stay the most salient elements. The coral title is unchanged.

MenuScreen: a full-screen navy 'AttractCover' Image (raycastTarget false) is the first sibling of the menu canvas (over the world, under the shades and content). It is disabled while its alpha is 0, so it costs no fill when idle. Tick tracks Director.Session.Sim: while the attract Sim has ended, the cover rises to 0.85 over 0.5 s. A new Simulation object (RestartAttract) starts a 0.2 s hold, then a fade to 0 at the same rate. OnShow resets the cover to 0. Helpers: MenuScreen.AttractCoverAlpha(ended, secondsSinceRestart, current, dt) as specified, plus an overload with secondsSinceEnded. One deviation found by the acceptance run: at 0.85 the remaining 15 % of the old board vanished in one frame at the swap (first capture, 99.31 -> 99.34 s). The cover now seals from 0.85 to 1.0 over 0.3 s, starting 0.45 s before GameSession.AttractRestartDelay, so the swap happens under an opaque cover. Tests: WaveC_AttractCoverRisesWhileEndedHoldsThenFallsAfterTheRestart and WaveC_AttractCoverSealsBeforeTheRestartSoTheSwapIsNeverSeen. Manual check on the final build, release player idle in the menu (540x960) captured every ~50 ms from 85 s to 102 s (docs/waveC/ui/attract_liquid: f_*.png, luma.txt, sequence_cover.png): fade to navy at 94.94-95.37 s, hold to 96.42 s, seal 96.42-96.70 s, opaque and luminance-constant (45.7) through the swap at about 96.9 s, new match fading in 97.04-97.66 s. No frame-to-frame luminance step above 4/255 in the whole sequence. A static cyan mark at the bottom of the window in those desktop captures is an external overlay: it sits at the same screen spot in all 315 frames, shows under the opaque cover where no game graphic can draw, and is absent from every in-game ScreenCapture.

ResultsScreen: dim 0.74 -> 0.86 (ResultsScreen.DimAlpha); cause and WHY paragraphs 940 -> 880 units wide (wrap on). Show/Fill call Layout(), which stacks the cause (top fixed at -815), WHY (skipped when empty), stats and tag from their measured preferredHeight with 40-unit gaps (30 above the tag), via the internal static ResultsScreen.StackLines. Text content is unchanged: UiStringsTests.Results_CauseAndWhyLines stays green. The standings list and ResultsZoom were not touched. Tests: WaveC_ResultsStackLeavesNoEmptyWhySlot, plus the results stack vs REJOUER check at 8 aspects. Release caught round at 540x960 (docs/waveC/ui/probe_liquid_540x960/results.png) and 540x1200 (ds_liquid_540x1200/liquid_results.png, probe_liquid_540x1200_final/results.png): measured empty band between the cause text and the stats text = 33 px at 960 px height (rows 465-497; it was 102 px, rows 465-566, in docs/waveB/shots/gate/liquid_results.png). Backdrop luminance behind the key numbers vs the gate shot: purple puddle 92.9 -> 72.6, brown 104.5 -> 81.7, teal 98.0 -> 71.9 (visibly darker).

MenuScreen.PreviewRepaintsPerSecond 30 -> 15. TickCards paints only the selected card's BiomePreview, once per 1/15 s tick, with a 1e-4 s tolerance so 60 fps gives exactly 15 paints. A card that loses the selection gets one Paint (a still frame) and then none. The constructor's first Paint is the still frame of each card at creation. BiomePreview: the rounded-corner alpha mask is computed once (static CornerMask byte[], applied per pixel), and an internal PaintCount counter was added. Tile size stays 128x80. Test WaveC_OnlyTheSelectedPreviewAnimatesAt15PerSecond: after 1 s of Tick at 60 fps the selected preview got 15 paints and each unselected one 0; after a selection change the old card got 1 paint and the new one 15; the mask is cached. Menu shots differ only by feel-06 (unselected previews show a still frame).

api_additions: UiKit.ScreenMatch (const CanvasScaler.ScreenMatchMode.Expand), UiKit.CanvasSizeFor(screenW, screenH), UiKit.SoftBandSprite, UiKit.SoftBandFeatherPixels; removed UiKit.MatchWidthOrHeight (no other user)

MenuScreen constants: TitleY, TitleHeight, SwatchY, CardRim, SelectedCardScale, CardRowWidth, CardRowMargin, BiomeLabelHeight, ScrimAlpha, ScrimBelowSwatches, ScrimAboveLabel, AttractCoverMax, AttractCoverFadeSeconds, AttractCoverRestartHold, AttractCoverSealSeconds, AttractCoverSealLead; PreviewRepaintsPerSecond now 15; internal CardRowScale, AttractCoverAlpha (2 overloads), AttractCoverValue, PreviewPaintCount

Hud constants: TopBarY, TopBarHeight, BoardTop, BoardRowHeight, BoardPadding, BoardHeight, ToastY, ToastHeight, ToastWrapHeight, MinToastScale, ToastSideMargin, ToastWrapMargin, ToastGap, ChevronAlpha, ChevronSize; internal ToastPlacement, ToastLayout (2 overloads), BoardRect
ResultsScreen constants: DimAlpha, ParagraphWidth, CauseTop, LineGap, TagGap, TagHeight, ReplayY, ReplaySize; internal LineStack, StackLines
BiomePreview internal PaintCount, internal static CornerMask
contract_issues: 15.1: 'CanvasScaler reference 1080 x 1920 match 0.5' becomes 'CanvasScaler reference 1080 x 1920, screenMatchMode Expand' (the whole design box is visible at every aspect; portrait screens taller than 9:16 get a canvas 1080 wide and taller than 1920, landscape and square screens one 1920 high and wider than 1080).
14 (Menu/attract): the attract drift is shown zoomed out, at view scale AttractZoom = 1.4 (25.2 u wide in 9:16), reached with the 0.5 s non-chase zoom ease.

15.2 / 25.1: only the selected biome card's preview animates (15 repaints per second); the unselected cards show a still frame on an opaque face. A soft navy scrim (alpha 0.45, 60-unit feathering) sits behind the Biome label, cards, color label and swatches, and a navy cover fades the ended attract board out (to 0.85, then opaque before the 2 s restart) and the next match in.

15.3 (toasts): a toast is never scaled below 0.85. With the leaderboard open it moves centered below the board (and below a visible tutorial bubble), and a line too long for one row wraps to two lines. The rival chevron is at alpha 0.9, 28x18, with a navy outline (layout unchanged, so 25.5 still holds).
15.5 (results, presentation only): navy dim 0.86, cause and WHY paragraphs 880 units wide, and lines stacked so an empty WHY line leaves no gap. Texts unchanged.
open_issues: Full EditMode suite (TestResults/ui_edit_full.xml, before the final MenuScreen seal edit): 486 tests, 1 failure, not in this package: WaveC_BiomeFireTests.WaveC_FirePackageFilesHaveNoEmDash (an em dash in the biome-fire package's own test file while they were mid-edit). All ui-owned suites are green in the full run and in the final filtered run (TestResults/ui_edit2.xml, 52/52).

On portrait screens taller than 9:16, Expand keeps the plan's top and bottom anchored positions, so the menu shows an empty band between the title and the Biome label (about 120 px at 540x1200). It is not a collision; centering the middle block would be a later layout polish.

In landscape the whole 1080 x 1920 design box must fit the 720 px height, so the UI is drawn at scale 0.375 (it was 0.667 with match 0.5). Text is smaller but nothing is cropped. Landscape is a Windows dev mode; phones are portrait.

Exact 1080x2400, 1080x2520 and 1200x1600 windows cannot be opened on this 1920x1200 desktop; they were checked at the same aspect (540x1200, 514x1200, 900x1200). The layout depends only on the aspect, and UiKit.CanvasSizeFor tests cover the exact sizes. A device check at 20:9 and 21:9 belongs in the brief 7.7 playtest.

With '-uidemo pause' the tutorial bubble stays visible under the pause dim, because the demo flag does not really pause the game (TutorialOverlay hides the bubble when GameDirector.IsPaused). This is demo-only and does not happen in real play.

The DevShot shots were taken on the first ui build. The final build only adds the attract cover seal (MenuScreen), which those shots cannot show. The final build was re-checked with probe PASS and hash 246577239DE179C4 at 540x960 and 540x1200, plus the attract capture.
needs: game-flow (TutorialOverlay.cs, optional): expose the visible bubble's vertical band (for example a public bool BubbleVisible and a public Rect BubbleRect in safe-area TopCenter coordinates). Hud currently finds the 'Bubble' child of the tutorial's safe area by name, read only, to keep a toast below it when the leaderboard is open; renaming that child would silently disable the avoidance (the board avoidance would still work).
